name: raven-xml
description: Completion, hovers and diagnostics for the XML interfaces of Raven: widgets, attributes, values and actions.

raven.xml.enable.description: Completion, hovers and diagnostics in the XML files of Raven.

raven.xml.files.markdownDescription: Glob patterns of XML files always treated as Raven files, whatever their root element (e.g. `**/ui/*.xml`). Others are recognized by their root: `<Window>`, `<Widgets>`, `<Widget>` or a widget of Raven.

raven.xml.exclude.markdownDescription: Glob patterns of XML files never treated as Raven files.

raven.xml.customTags.markdownDescription: Tags registered from C with `Rxml_register_tag`: they are accepted, with any attribute.

raven.xml.diagnostics.description: Report the unknown tags and attributes, the invalid values and the mistakes of structure.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run check && npm run build
